criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

In product.py implement Product(name, price, stock). Store all three attributes. Create Pen at 200/4 and Book at 500/7; show each attribute and prove the instances differ. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add inventory_value(self) returning price * stock. Pen initially returns 800; a zero-stock product returns 0. Return a number rather than only printing. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Reject blank names and negative prices or stock with ValueError. Accept zero price and stock. Demonstrate a valid object and each rejected field. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add restock(quantity), requiring a positive integer and rejecting bool. Starting at 4, adding 3 leaves 7; adding 0 or -1 raises ValueError and leaves 7. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add sell(quantity). Require a positive integer no greater than stock; return the sale total. Selling 2 at 200 leaves stock 5 after the restock and returns 400. Overselling leaves stock unchanged. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Set alias = pen and change alias.stock. Record why pen changes too while book does not. Then create a separate Product with matching values and explain identity versus equal field values. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Store three Product objects in a list and total their values using the method. Include one zero-stock item. Print item names and total; calculate the same result by hand. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
